attribution.//: Empty strings suppress Claude's attribution. `commit` drops the Co-Authored-By trailer; `pr` drops the "Generated with Claude Code" footer from PR bodies. The two are independent — set only one to "" to keep the other. Preferred over the deprecated includeCoAuthoredBy, which forces both together.

permissions.//: Commands that write to the repo or to GitHub — git commit, git push, git checkout, and every gh command that mutates — are intentionally absent from allow so they keep prompting for human approval, per CLAUDE.md's working agreements: don't commit, push, or bump versions unless asked. Read-only gh issue queries are allowlisted because repo-auditor opens every audit with them. git add is allowlisted but the whole-tree forms are denied, since release-manager.md requires staging only relevant files.
